items.description: Deterministic SanMar API toolkit — wraps SanMar's SOAP web services and PromoStandards order-shipment service behind typed CLI tools. Search products, check real-time warehouse inventory, pull customer-specific (myPrice) pricing, validate carts, submit and track purchase orders, parse PO PDFs, and resolve marketing color names to SanMar mainframe color codes. Use whenever the user needs to read from or write to SanMar for apparel sourcing, pricing, ordering, or order tracking.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the deterministic SanMar API toolkit.

- Wraps SanMar's SOAP web services and PromoStandards order-shipment service with typed CLI tools.
- Supports product search, inventory and pricing checks, cart validation, purchase order submission/tracking, PO PDF parsing, and color code resolution.
- Purely deterministic JSON-in/JSON-out interface, no external dependencies except Python 3.11+ and requests.
- Supports optional features (PDF parse, SFTP color resolution) with pypdf/paramiko.
- All actions accessible via a single CLI entrypoint.
- Credentials are provided via environment variables or inline JSON; FTP credentials are handled separately.
- Only purchase order creation is write-capable and requires explicit confirmation; all other actions are safe reads.

items.description: Use when the user asks to optimize, improve, or rewrite a prompt, or when a vague request needs to be turned into a precise instruction. Two engines: 3300+ template library + LLM meta-prompting. Do NOT use for general conversation or code review.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major 4.0.0 update: Dual-engine prompt optimization with intelligent onboarding, granular platform adaptation, and persistent user preferences.

- Introduces a dual-engine system: 3,300+ prompt template library with LLM meta-prompting fallback.
- Intelligent onboarding asks first-time users about use case, engine, format, and template preferences.
- Auto-detects platform capabilities (file I/O & large file support) and downgrades features accordingly.
- User state (“on/off”, engine, format, selected categories) is persisted; can be changed with natural commands.
- Supports per-category template loading; reduces memory and token use.
- Adds multiple prompt optimization frameworks (general, analytical, iterative, query refinement).
- Supports optional prompt quality evaluation with scoring report.
- Only activates on explicit command; avoids general conversation or code review.

items.description:
Use CADT probe service to discover cloud resources under an Alibaba Cloud account. Use this skill when users need to:
(1) Discover existing cloud resources via CADT probe
(2) Inventory existing resource list
(3) Export resource list for CADT architecture import
(4) Understand resource distribution within an account
(5) Query related/associated resources for a specific resource (e.g., find security groups and vswitches linked to an ECS instance)

Trigger words: resource probe, CADT probe, probe, resource inventory, list resources, view cloud resources, related resources, associated resources, resource relationships

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-cadt-probe.

- Enables discovery of cloud resources in an Alibaba Cloud account using the CADT probe service (BPStudio API).
- Supports inventory, export, and relationship queries for resources across 20+ Alibaba Cloud services.
- Flexible output options including human-readable and machine/script-friendly JSON, with automatic handling for large result sets.
- Includes options for querying related/associated resources, summary-only output, and output-size management.
- Provides RAM permission requirements and clear error-handling guidance for permission issues.
